India Observes National Doctors' Day with Focus on Healthcare and Doctor Contributions

India celebrated National Doctors' Day on July 1st, an occasion to honor physicians and discuss the healthcare landscape. Events and reports highlighted the contributions of doctors, the importance of preventive healthcare, and the need for compassion in medical practice. Discussions also touched upon the history of the day and expert advice for healthier living.
